block.guhs.skyblok_fles.lore: THE island, only tiny. Tree, bed and all. The cobblestone generator didn't fit in anymore, Nyeg.
item.guhs.skyblok_fles.lore: THE island, only tiny. Tree, bed and all. The cobblestone generator didn't fit in anymore, Nyeg.
subtitles.guhs.vadsnite.sprong: Guhs jump out of the Chonk Bus
gui.guhs.skyblok.gids.uitleg: Three famous minigames, the guh way. Talk to the game guhs in the lobby. The first time you get 100 coins and a keepsake; after that you can play as often as you like.
gui.guhs.skyblok.grap.uitleg: One island, one tree and a manual of 4,812 steps. For real pros only, says the Skyblok Guh.
gui.guhs.skyblok.grap.stap.4: Give up and lie down in the bed
gui.guhs.skyblok.clou.onder: You lay down. That was all, Nyeg.
quest.guhs.skyblok.hallo: Quiet. I'm in a call. ...Okay. %s, this is Skyblok. One island. One tree. Four thousand eight hundred and twelve steps. For real pros only, Nyeg. Do you dare?
quest.guhs.skyblok.hallo.opnieuw: You again, %s. You completed Skyblok. Nobody completes Skyblok! I've been training on step 1 for three years. ...Want another go?
quest.guhs.skyblok.uitleg: You stand on THE island, high up in the sky. Very high. Real sky, honest, nothing fake about it. Follow the manual at the top of your screen. And whatever you do: do NOT lie down in that bed. That's for beginners, Nyeg.
quest.guhs.skyblok.kwijt.hier: Tsk. A pro doesn't lose their stuff. Here, a new Island in a Bottle. Take good care of it, Nyeg.
quest.guhs.skyblok.kwijt.nee: You still have it. Take a good look in your pockets, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.begin: Welcome to THE island! Follow the manual at the top of your screen. Good luck. You're going to need it, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.handleiding.balk: Step 1 of %s: make a cobblestone generator
gui.guhs.skyblok.hint.bed: Psst... that bed does look awfully soft, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.leegte: You fell into the endless void! Well... it's a floor. Painted light blue. Have a nice look around, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.leegte.terug: Up you go, back to your island. The void is closing soon, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.1: That doesn't work. Try step 1 again, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.3: The manual says: a cobblestone generator first.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.4: Hmm. Skyblok is hard, isn't it?
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.5: 4,812 steps to go. Or... that bed?
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.deur: Staff only, Nyeg! Back to your island, you.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.werkbank: Crafting? Without a cobblestone generator? Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.lava: The lava stays in the bucket. It's a little shy, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.ijs: The ice won't leave your pawsies. Nice and cool, though.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.lucht: That's the sky! Don't touch, the paint is still wet.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.boom: The tree belongs to the set guhs. Paws off, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.breken: There's only one island. Keep it in one piece, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.nee.plaatsen: Building isn't allowed until step 2,406, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.skyblok.einde: You lay down. That was the whole game! The goal in life is chonking, not building a cobblestone generator. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.skyblok.aftiteling.5.naam: by brush, by the set guhs
gui.guhs.bedwars.grap.uitleg: Four teams want to get to your bed. You defend it, with everything you've got. Says the Bedwars Guh, in his armor made of pillows.
gui.guhs.bedwars.grap.stap.3: Stay in bed, the teams are coming
gui.guhs.bedwars.grap.stap.4: Make room: they only want to join you
quest.guhs.bedwars.hallo: HALT! Who goes there? Oh, %s. I'm the Bedwars Guh. See this armor? Real pillows. Down! In Bedwars there is only one rule: defend your bed. With everything you've got, Nyeg!
quest.guhs.bedwars.hallo.opnieuw: There's %s, the best bed defender in all of Guhpixel! Zero beds destroyed. ZERO. Want to defend your bed once more?
quest.guhs.bedwars.uitleg: You get a little island with a bed. Four teams live around you: Red, Blue, Green and Yellow. They're coming, over little bridges of wool. You defend your bed. How? You'll find out. Tip: it's a really comfy bed, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bedwars.begin: This is your island, with your bed. The other teams have already spotted it, Nyeg...
gui.guhs.bedwars.titel.verdedig.onder: They're coming over the wool, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bedwars.ligt: You're lying in your bed. Now nobody can get to it. Perfect defense, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bedwars.aangekomen: %s is on your island! ...and waits politely at the edge.
gui.guhs.bedwars.dutje: %1$s lies down next to your bed. Zzz... (naps: %2$s)
gui.guhs.bedwars.hint.terug: Back into bed, Nyeg! You're not defending anything like this.
gui.guhs.bedwars.hint.wachten: They're waiting politely until you're in your bed, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bedwars.hint.bed: The best way to defend your bed is to lie down in it, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bedwars.guh.njeg: %s: "Nyeg. Any room left by that bed?"
gui.guhs.bedwars.nee.bed: Break your own bed? That's not even in the rules, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.bedwars.nee.breken: No breaking. This is Bedwars, not Breakwars, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.grap.uitleg: A hundred jump out of the flying Chonk Bus. One is left. The Chonknite Guh already has his parachute pack on.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.clou.onder: You're the only one still awake, Nyeg!
quest.guhs.vadsnite.hallo: Yo %s! Up for a round of Chonknite? A hundred jump out, one is left. Usually the one who stays awake the longest, Nyeg. Pack on and go!
quest.guhs.vadsnite.hallo.opnieuw: %s! The champion! Everyone is still talking about your Chonk Royale. Well... everyone was asleep. Another round?
quest.guhs.vadsnite.uitleg: You fly over a little island in the Chonk Bus with 99 guhs. Jump through the hatch, float down and be the last one left. Watch out for the sleep cloud: it's pink, soft and keeps coming closer. It doesn't do anything, honest. It's just very cozy, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.begin: Welcome aboard the Chonk Bus! We're flying over the island. The hatch is at the back, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.duwtje: The driver lends a paw: off you go, through the hatch!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.geland: Landed! Now just be the last one awake. That can never take long, Nyeg...
gui.guhs.vadsnite.wolk: Yaaawn... the sleep cloud. Pink and soft. Nothing happens, but it sure is cozy, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.gelijkspel.onder: Everyone is asleep. It's a draw, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.vadsnite.einde.gelijkspel: You lay down too. Now really everyone is asleep. That simply counts, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.einde.overwinning: All %s guhs are asleep. You're the only one still awake. You didn't have to do a thing. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.vadsnite.nee.breken: Chopping wood? In Chonknite we only nap, Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.skyblok_klaar.title: Skyblok Completed
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.skyblok_klaar.desc: Talk to the &dSkyblok Guh&r in the &dGuhpixel&r lobby and travel to THE island. The manual has 4,812 steps. Nobody has ever reached step 2... but there is said to be a shortcut, Nyeg. The first time you get 100 coins and a keepsake.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.bedwars_klaar.title: Bed Defended
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.bedwars_klaar.desc: Talk to the &dBedwars Guh&r in the &dGuhpixel&r lobby. Four teams come to your island over little bridges of wool. Defend your bed, with everything you've got! The first time you get 100 coins and a keepsake.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.vadsnite_klaar.title: Chonk Royale
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.vadsnite_klaar.desc: Talk to the &dChonknite Guh&r in the &dGuhpixel&r lobby and jump out of the flying &dChonk Bus&r with 99 guhs. Whoever stays awake the longest wins. The first time you get 100 coins and a keepsake.
